column1: # Models for the packaged runtime and a source install, which share one layout:
# <model dir>/<file>. File names are the ones animejanai.conf slots and the
# built-in slots 1001-1003 (src/aji_conf.cpp) refer to. deploy.sh and
# Tab-separated: group, kind, file, sha256, url, mirror ("-" = none).
#   apisr  tools/prepare_apisr.py, which pins its own source digest
#   rife   the fp16 model from upstream's RIFE release archive at <url> (one
#          archive holds every version; tools/convert_rife_fp16.py made them
#          from vs-mlrt). <sha256> is the extracted model's.
